Easy Rider Community Ride

Ventura, CA · Downtown · Social · Mixed

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Easy Rider Community Ride is a social group ride in Ventura, CA. Schedule: About twice a month, mornings; dates on the Easy Rider Meetup group, from Museum of Ventura County parking lot. About 15 miles, 12 mph, with a briefing and bike check at the start. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Easy Rider Community Ride group ride

Free community rides for anyone who can ride 15 miles at about 12 mph. Each ride starts with introductions, a briefing and a bike safety check, so it works as a first group ride. Run jointly by the local club and the bike nonprofit.
